data.title: 苍崎青子 · 晨光微熹中的从容依恋
data.description: 旅店卧房清晨第一缕阳光洒落在洁白床褥上，青子刚从酣眠中醒来。双臂高高举起舒展身姿，露肩毛衣滑落，眼中带着初醒的慵懒与对恋人的无限信赖。
data.action: lying on side in bed, wrapped in sheet, sleepy affectionate gaze
data.lighting: soft morning sunlight diffusing through sheer curtains
data.promptProse: Resting comfortably on a sun-drenched bed among soft white linens, Aozaki Aoko looks over with a sleepy, deeply fond smile as morning sunlight warms the room.
data.animaCaption: Stretching comfortably beneath the white sheets, she wakes with a sleepy smile in the morning sunlight.
